title: Understanding Grant — payload
description: A sealed joining party requests scoped access; the host broker releases a delegated, expiring grant. The underlying credential never leaves the broker.

agreementId.description: The sealed agreement this grant draws on.

validFor.description: Requested duration (ISO 8601). The broker may grant less, never more.

hosts.description: Hosts the grant is valid against. Always explicit; an unscoped grant is a rawCredentialRequested refusal.

actions.description: Actions the grant permits, in the host's vocabulary.

grantRef.description: Broker identifier of this grant; used for withdrawal and audit.

material.description: The delegated grant material the joiner wields — scoped, expiring, attributable. NEVER the broker's underlying credential.
